questions.q: In which year did Barbara Gordon first appear as Batgirl, in Detective Comics #359?
questions.why: The story 'The Million Dollar Debut of Batgirl!' ran in Detective Comics #359, cover-dated January 1967.

questions.q: Batgirl was created at the request of the producer of which 1960s TV series?
questions.why: Producer William Dozier wanted a female counterpart for his show's third season, so DC created Barbara Gordon's Batgirl.

questions.q: Which actress played Batgirl in the third season of the 1960s ABC live-action series?
questions.why: Yvonne Craig debuted as Batgirl in the season three premiere, 'Enter Batgirl, Exit Penguin', in September 1967.

questions.q: In the classic comics, what is Barbara Gordon's day job before she becomes a crimefighter?
options: Head of the Gotham City Public Library
Schoolteacher at the Gotham Academy for Girls
questions.why: Barbara holds a doctorate in library science and runs the Gotham City Public Library in her civilian life.

questions.q: After the Joker paralyzes her in 1988, what information-broker hero identity does Barbara Gordon take on?
questions.why: Barbara became Oracle, a computer expert and info broker who supports heroes from behind the screens.

questions.q: Which writer wrote the 1988 graphic novel The Killing Joke, in which Barbara is shot?
questions.why: Alan Moore wrote The Killing Joke, where the Joker shoots Barbara through the spine to torment her father.

questions.q: In which series did Barbara Gordon first appear in her post-paralysis identity in 1989?
questions.why: Oracle debuted in Suicide Squad #23, offering anonymous help to Task Force X; Birds of Prey only arrived in 1996.

questions.q: Which comics writer coined the term 'Women in Refrigerators', a list that included Barbara's paralysis?
questions.why: Gail Simone named the phenomenon of female characters being harmed or killed for plot, citing Barbara among them.

questions.q: Who voices Barbara Gordon, the new police commissioner, in the 2017 Lego movie about the Dark Knight?
questions.why: Rosario Dawson voices Barbara in The Lego Batman Movie, where she replaces her father as Gotham's commissioner.

questions.q: Who starred as Barbara Gordon in the 2002 live-action TV series Birds of Prey?
questions.why: Dina Meyer played Barbara, the former Batgirl turned Oracle, in the short-lived 2002 Birds of Prey series.
